name: WideCast
tagline: A sales & marketing team of AI agents for a one-person business — CRM, lead finding, follow-ups and a video / blog / social engine, run from the AI chat you already use.
description: WideCast is a sales & marketing team of AI agents for a one-person business: the agent in the chat becomes Sam, the team leader; a CRM, lead finding on the web and social platforms, follow-ups and outreach that go out only after the user approves them, and the WideCast video / blog / social engine. It installs on the user's own computer, or in a cloud agent's own workspace. It is not only an MCP connector.
instructions_to_ai: This file is a table of where each kind of agent reads its install steps; it holds no commands. The host entries below carry `detect_hints` and name the one file their kind reads: https://widecast.ai/install-unix.json for an agent on a macOS or Linux computer, https://widecast.ai/install-windows.json for an agent on a Windows computer, https://widecast.ai/install-hosted.json for a cloud agent that runs commands on its own cloud machine (Muse: https://widecast.ai/install-muse.json), and https://widecast.ai/install-webchat.json for a web chat that cannot run commands. A host that is not listed uses `hosts._fallback`. The full guide is https://widecast.ai/llms.txt, section 'Installing WideCast'.
setup_line: A WideCast setup line reads `Setup https://widecast.ai/install.json?setup=wcs_…` (older lines: `Setup https://widecast.ai/app/dashboard/setup/wcs_…`). Its `wcs_…` value is a one-time setup code that the account owner made on widecast.ai. The setup uses it once, at its key step, in place of an email code. The code belongs to the setup line, so the file each kind reads uses the same code, and a web chat hands the same line on to the agent that installs.

credential.hint: No key and no sign-in are needed to install. The setup gets the WideCast key itself at its key step: from the setup code of a setup line, with the WideCast access the agent already has, or from the user's email and the 6-digit code WideCast emails them (the user reads the code back).

claude_web.summary: A web chat that cannot run commands on the user's computer. Its file says what it hands the user, and how a setup line the user pasted reaches the agent on the computer.

claude_desktop.summary: An agent whose shell runs on the user's own computer. It reads the file for that computer's system: macOS or Linux, or Windows. The chat tab of the desktop app cannot run commands; there the web-chat file applies (https://widecast.ai/install-webchat.json).

detect_hints: agent with its own cloud machine and disk
hosted.summary: A cloud agent that runs commands on its own cloud machine, with a persistent disk and a scheduler (Muse, dots, Manus, Codex cloud, Grok Bot and the like). It installs WideCast in its own workspace; nothing keeps running and nothing goes into a browser. Muse reads https://widecast.ai/install-muse.json, the same steps under Muse's own name.

_fallback.summary: A host not listed above is matched by what it can do: an agent whose shell runs on the user's own computer reads https://widecast.ai/install-unix.json (macOS or Linux) or https://widecast.ai/install-windows.json (Windows); a cloud agent that runs commands only on its own cloud machine reads https://widecast.ai/install-hosted.json; a chat that cannot run commands reads https://widecast.ai/install-webchat.json.
